summary: Frontend-only verification of public legal shell, authed layout regression, AdminLanding publish feedback/sync, and home Legal section. 3 of 4 features PASS. Publish toast FAILS: sonner <Toaster /> is never mounted in the app, so toast.success/error calls render nothing.

ui_bugs.issue: No toast appears after Publish (0 [data-sonner-toaster]/[data-sonner-toast] elements in DOM). RCA: grep finds no '<Toaster' usage in src (App.js/index.js); components/ui/sonner.jsx exports Toaster but it's never rendered. All toast() calls across app (AdminUsers, VendorOrders, ErpRoles, etc.) are silent. Inline fallback data-testid='admin-landing-msg' does show 'Published! Every visitor of slangcart.com now sees this content.' but it sits at the top of the page, off-screen when user clicks the bottom sticky Publish button.

passed: Logged-out /legal/terms and /legal/privacy: public-layout, public-brand, public-signin, public-home, app-legal-footer present; sidebar absent; no logout; legal-content has real policy text (~480-520 chars); no redirect to /login
Authed admin /admin/landing: sidebar present, public-layout absent, admin-landing loads; authed /legal/terms also uses sidebar shell
Publish sync: marker QA2-<ts> published; fresh browser context on '/' shows marker in hero
Home section-legal with legal-card-terms/privacy/refund/contact_us/about; clicking refund opens /legal/refund with content
action_items: Mount sonner Toaster once at app root, e.g. in App.js: import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/sonner'; render <Toaster position="top-center" richColors /> inside the router/provider tree. (Check ui/sonner.jsx uses next-themes useTheme — ensure it works without a ThemeProvider or pass theme='light'.)
Optionally scroll admin-landing-msg into view or place it next to the sticky publish bar
critical_code_review_comments: sonner toast used in ~10 files but Toaster never mounted — app-wide silent feedback
seed_data_creation: Published hero_subtitle = 'QA2-1793168135' to landing CMS (reversible; main agent may want to restore original subtitle).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After Toaster is mounted, re-run: admin login -> /admin/landing -> fill cms-hero_subtitle -> click cms-publish -> expect [data-sonner-toast] visible in viewport. Hero subtitle currently holds a QA2 marker.
